thresholds.rule: deficit_mm = et_mm - rain_mm, computed per dekad on the union-council (tehsil) mean

amber.label_en: Deficit of 1 to 30 mm; one irrigation turn covers it

red.label_en: Deficit above 30 mm; stress likely if canal water is late

nodata.label_en: No irrigated winter cereals, or a source was missing

thresholds.rationale: Rabi wheat in the Peshawar valley uses about 3 to 4 mm/day in Nov-Dec, i.e. 30 to 40 mm per dekad. A single canal irrigation turn delivers roughly 30 mm (75 mm depth applied at 40% efficiency). See docs/thresholds.md.

water_demand.name: Reference evapotranspiration (FAO-56 Penman-Monteith) from NASA POWER daily weather
water_demand.dataset: NASA POWER T2M_MAX, T2M_MIN, RH2M, WS2M, ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN, PS

rain.name: NASA POWER daily bias-corrected precipitation (PRECTOTCORR, MERRA-2)

cropland.name: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200, class 40 cropland, 10 m
cropland.dataset: esa-worldcover public bucket, statistics at about 75 m

crop_type.name: ESA WorldCereal 2021 v100: winter cereals, maize, active irrigation
crop_type.note: Needs Earth Engine credentials. Until then these hectares are reported as unavailable rather than estimated.

boundaries.name: geoBoundaries gbOpen Pakistan ADM2 districts (2019) and ADM3 tehsils (2017)
boundaries.note: Level-3 units are tehsils, not union councils; 31 districts, not 35.

unit_note: Level-3 units are tehsils from geoBoundaries until union-council polygons are sourced.
